claim_boundary: Each result verifies that one exact public statement appeared in the fetched UNCTAD Digital Economy Report 2024 Chapter V: E-commerce and environmental sustainability bytes on 2026-09-07. It does not independently establish the statement's underlying real-world truth.
review_design: retrospective deterministic source-publication audit; not preregistered, not an independent fact-check, and not an independent reproduction
source_name: UNCTAD Digital Economy Report 2024 Chapter V: E-commerce and environmental sustainability
selection_method: Deterministic sentence extraction with minimum length and prose-quality filters, signal scoring, duplicate removal, and per-page concentration limits.
